name: v4.0.539
body:
## What's Changed

- `@remotion/effects`: [Add `curves()` and graphical color controls in Studio](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/effects/curves) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12550
- `@remotion/effects`: [Add `shatter()` for 3D fragment animations](https://www.remotion.dev/docs/effects/shatter) by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12578
- `remotion`: Fix `spring()` overshoot clamping with custom ranges by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12552
- `remotion`: Fix hue angles in `interpolateColors()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12574
- `remotion`: Fix multi-keyframe loops in `interpolate()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12587
- `remotion`: Fix `prefetch()` cleanup for shared assets by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12591
- `remotion`: Close animated image frames when evicted from cache by @WhyTan00 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12571
- `remotion`: Avoid repeated Tailwind scans in `AbsoluteFill` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12545
- `@remotion/animation-utils`: Fix 3D transforms in `interpolateStyles()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12554
- `@remotion/cli`: Add render usage flags and fix Lambda telemetry by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12596
- `@remotion/lambda`: Actually run the launch handler's cleanup tasks by @parbhatkapila4 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12521
- `@remotion/lambda-php`: Add `renderStillOnLambda()` by @DeryFerd in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12524
- `@remotion/media`: Bound the preview reveal frame cache by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12540
- `@remotion/media`: Release abandoned preview startup on disposal by @alec-watts in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12541
- `@remotion/media-utils`: Fix non-finite values in `visualizeAudio()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12555
- `@remotion/media-utils`: Ignore stale `useAudioData()` requests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12570
- `@remotion/media-utils`: Fix audio context leaks in `getAudioData()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12576
- `@remotion/media-utils`: Fix multichannel audio corruption in `audioBufferToDataUrl()` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12586
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix geometry of relative quadratic paths by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12547
- `@remotion/paths`: Fix `translatePath()` for paths starting with `m` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12553
- `@remotion/player`: Fix browser rewind and fast-forward seeking by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12543
- `@remotion/player`: Fix component updates with `noSuspense` by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12579
- `@remotion/player`: Fix keyboard trapping in the playback-speed menu by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12581
- `@remotion/renderer`: Don't deadlock when concurrent renders merge 32+ audio tracks by @parbhatkapila4 in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12539
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix downloads with relative redirect paths by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12549
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix oversized suffix byte-range requests by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12584
- `@remotion/renderer`: Fix localhost port collisions with IPv6 servers by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12585
- `@remotion/studio`: Speed up remapping large selections after source edits by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12544
- `@remotion/studio`: Speed up move and resize setup for large selections by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12546
- `@remotion/studio`: Speed up resizing large TransitionSeries selections by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12548
- `@remotion/studio`: Skip unchanged expanded timeline trees during playback by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12551
- `@remotion/studio-server`: Fix API requests rejected behind HTTPS reverse proxies by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12575
- `@remotion/transitions`: Fix capturing bare `OffthreadVideo` scenes by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12561

## Elements

- Fix Browse Elements in Safari on remotion.dev/new by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12562
- Fix cross-origin drag-and-drop in Safari by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12567
- Add error and retry screens for Studio library loading by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12572

## Docs

- Add GitHub CLI skill installation command by @tommaso-moro in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12530
- Update browser bug statuses and Chrome fix versions by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12538
- Mark HTML-in-canvas object-fit bug as fixed by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12590
- Define non-profit in license FAQ by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12557
- Align non-profit FAQ with terms by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12558
- Link Free License eligibility from pricing by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12537
- Move "Why is there no Remotion app?" article to FAQ by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/dac0f8541a
- Fix warning admonitions in player preloading guide by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/3266d0b58f

## Internal and Experimental

- Homepage: Add experimental homepage with synchronized Studio handoff by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/870b8a614c
- Homepage: Add styled Convert demo to explore section by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/7830ef2f55
- remotion.dev/convert: Match site navigation across Convert and test media by @JonnyBurger in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/commit/2bd172f29a
- Internal testbed: Fix CommittedRenderHolds without ImageDecoder by @samohovets in https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/pull/12569

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion/compare/v4.0.538...v4.0.539
